scientific_integrity: Exact matrix/determinant proof and two executable corroborating checkers; numeric enumerations are not substituted for infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to finite linear repeated increasing ternary blocks; no claim for arbitrary block orders, larger alphabets, or a proven optimal exponential base. Prior equivalent may be unindexed.
title: Exact ternary minimal-absent-subsequence length spectrum for repeated increasing blocks
